title: Procurement of DSLR camera and its Accessories under Goa Directorate - Reg.
summary: GeM bid for supply of a full-frame DSLR camera with mount adapter, standard zoom lens, camera bag, tripod, two 256 GB SDXC cards and a 3-year Adobe Photoshop subscription for the Goa Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa

sites.name: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhawan, Near GMC Stadium, Bambolim, Goa 403202
sites.work: Consignee for DSLR camera and accessories

scope.item: DSLR Camera with Mount Adapter (still DSLR full frame, CMOS, 24 MP or more, Z mount, 4K video, 3.1-3.5 inch TFT touch screen, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/USB, SD up to 256 GB, Li-Ion 1900 mAh or more with charger), warranty minimum 2 years
Auto Standard Zoom DSLR Camera Lens (Z mount, 80 mm filter, 70 mm focal length, full frame, max aperture 2.8, 9 diaphragm blades, image stabilisation), warranty minimum 2 years
Branded camera bag (holds two DSLRs and eight lenses, customizable dividers, removable waist belt, all-weather cover, tripod carry)
Tripod with aluminium alloy ball head (folded 739 mm, extended 1734 mm, min 233 mm, max load 7 kg, 360 deg panoramic, quick release plate), warranty 2 years
Adobe Photoshop computer software, 3 years subscription

money.notes: Estimated bid value per GeM. EMD exemption per GeM GTC (MSE manufacturers; traders excluded). MII and MSE purchase preference apply. Scope: only supply of goods.

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years): Rs 2 lakh
OEM average turnover (last 3 years): Rs 20 lakh
3 years past experience supplying same/similar category products to Central/State Govt/PSU
Past performance: 30% of bid quantity supplied in one of last three financial years
MSE and startup exemption from experience and turnover
Only Class-I and Class-II local suppliers (minimum 50%/20% local content)
BIS compulsory registration (Scheme-II, IS 616:2017) for the camera category
Technical brochure with make and model and compliance sheet as per scope of work
specs: GeM category: DSLR/Compact/Handheld Camcorder or Video Cameras (V2); still DSLR full frame, CMOS, 35.6-35.9 x 23.8-24 mm sensor, 24 MP, ISO 51200 or higher, detachable lens, 4K (3840x2160) video, HDMI, MOV/MP4, touch vari-angle 3.1-3.5 inch display, SD/CF/XQD up to 512 GB, Li-Ion
Buyer item specification: Z mount, focal length 27/70 mm, aperture 3.5/5.6, mini HDMI, built-in flash, memory card up to 256 GB, 1900 mAh battery
notes: 9-page GeM bid document merged with 3-page scanned buyer item specification (OCR text layer legible). BOQ excel referenced but not included. Buyer specification (Z mount, 27/70 mm focal length, built-in flash, 256 GB) differs from GeM category specification (14-800 mm, external flash, 512 GB). Bid end 07-02-2025 18:00, opening 18:30. Buyer e-mail and consignee officer's name and mobile numbers not recorded [personal contact removed].
